  class FailingTask(), SuspendTask<Int>
    public suspend fun run
  class RecordingCompletion(), Continuation<Int>
    public fun resume
    public fun resumeWithException
  fun launch(task: SuspendTask<Int>, completion: Continuation<Int>)
    Call startCoroutine
      Var task
      Var completion
  fun main()
    Call launch
      Call FailingTask
